What is the PC Parts Marketplace all about?

A marketplace setup for pc enthusiasts to buy, sell, or trade their new or used working parts only!

 

What are examples of acceptable items to buy, sell, or trade on the PC Parts Marketplace?

  1. Brand New In box Intel 5930K, that you purchased for a build from Newegg, and decided to no longer use and sell
  2. Used Motherboard that is in working condition that you`d like to sell that you no longer need since you upgraded.
  3. Trade your used, but in working condition Titan X for a pair for 980 Tis and some cash.
  4. Purchase a used SSD and in working condition EVO to upgrade your current mechanical hard drive

What are not examples of acceptable items to buy, sell, or trade on the PC Parts Marketplace?

  1. Brand New In box Apple iPhone 6
  2. Used Motherboard that is in working condition minus the USB 3.0 connector that needs to be wiggled to work
  3. Trade your used, but in working condition Titan X which you modded incorrectly
  4. Listing an item that you know is broken.
  5. Listing Parts that you do not have.

 

What are the rules for purchasing, selling, and trading on the PC Parts Marketplace?

Condition of the Item:

  1. The item must be in working condition. It must function as designed by the manufacturer. If it does not, then the item is not in working condition.
  2. The required practice here is to document all imperfections such as scratches, dents, and other cosmetic issues on the part, to prevent confusion or misrepresent the item.
  3. Pictures of the above imperfections is mandatory. These pictures will need a verification logo of sorts. This logo should only include the date and user name.
  4. If the item is Brand New In Box, the picture of the item and seal must be visible. If the seal is broken the item is not considered BNIB.
  5. List all supporting documents, original retail packaging, accessories included or missing.
  6. Failure to do any of the following will be grounds for removal of post, and future marketplace privileges.

Verification of the Item:

  1. The item must be in your possession at the time of posting.
  2. To verify the item please post pictures of the item with your username, time of day, and calendar date.
  3. Provide pictures of the item with imperfections, factory seals if applicable, and any other information a potential buyer, seller, or trader might need or help assist with this transaction
  4. Failure to do any of the following will be grounds for removal of post, and future marketplace privileges.

Communication:

  1. Initial Contact must be made on the thread. Do not contact via messaging.
  2. Save all communications between all parties involved.
  3. If possible, get a landline phone number and address to the parties involved in case unfortunate happens.
  4. Always refer to the thread and item when discussing the matter in a post. It helps prevent confusion as to what item is being talked about.
  5. Failure to do any of the following will be grounds for removal of post, and future marketplace privileges.

Payment and Transactions:

  1. This Marketplace allows all forms of payment methods, as we understand not everyone adheres to a specific payment method. However we do recommend certain tips to avoid unfortunate events such as fraud.
  2. As a buyer, make sure the item is paid for by PayPal or any other payment method that offers some sort of buyer protection. If the item arrives in a condition other than what was posted, you have methods of recourse.
  3. As a seller, make sure the item is insured, and requires signature confirmation. If the item is damaged in shipping, the carrier is responsible. The only recognized delivery confirmation is a signature.
  4. As a trader make sure the terms of the trade are hashed out, and you ship at the same time or each have some kind of collateral to avoid fraudulent traders.
  5. We offer a service that attempts to prevent fraudulent transactions. More about this is below.
  6. Failure to do any of the following will be grounds for removal of post, and future marketplace privileges.

Shipping

  1. This marketplace allows all forms of responsible shipping, and local pickup. Responsible shipping is defined as packaging an item properly, and ensuring the safe arrival of the item to the buyer or trader. An example of this is careful packaging of a laptop with foam peanuts in an adequate shipping box. An example of poor shipping is shipping a laptop in a flat rate shipping container without any form of padding.
  2. Insurance is recommended to ensure any damage by the carrier is covered. Certain carriers do not honor shipping if the packaging is done by anyone besides their company owned office (example is UPS).
  3. The only recognized form of delivery confirmation by all payment methods is the signature confirmation feature. We recommend this to avoid any wrongly delivered items.

Trader Reputation

  1. All users on this marketplace must have a HEATWARE Account setup with a valid email and voat username associated with that account. Here is the link to: www.heatware.com
  2. Heatware is an online trading reputation site that tracks recent buying, selling, or trading experiences throughout various pc marketplaces in the form of Heat (another term of user experiences). Users can submit detailed accounts of what worked and what didnt work. Users can also submit receive three ratings for a transaction; Positive (For a great experience), Neutral (For an experience that was semi problematic but ultimately worked), or Negative (For a terrible experience such as user fraud).
  3. Any other form of online trading reputation is not valid on this marketplace.
  4. We understand that not everyone will have a significant amount of heat, but will eventually build up as they progress on this marketplace.
  5. We strongly recommend buyers, sellers, and traders alike to exercise caution and use heatware as a supplementary tool to evaluate potential buyers, sellers, and traders. The first and foremost tool we recommend is a simple google search of the buyers, seller, and traders username or even personal information to see if any red flags pop out.

What are the rules for posting on the PC Parts Marketplace?

  1. Please use the following format for the title and message of a buying post:

Title

[B] [W] ASUS STRIX GTX970 [$] PP [Z] 95122 CA

  • [B]=Buying
  • [W]= The item that you are looking to buy
  • [$]= Payment Method
  • [Z]= Shipping zip code or country

Message

  1. Heatware: USERNAME
  2. Looking to buy: ASUS Strix Gtx970
  3. Condition: New
  4. Payment: PayPal/PP
  5. Shipping: 95122
  6. Extra Concerns: Need original invoice
  1. Please use the following format for the title and message of a selling post:

Title

[S] [H] ASUS STRIX GTX970 [L$] PP

  • [S]=Selling
  • [H]= The item that you are looking to sell and have
  • [L$]= What you want in return

Message

  1. Heatware: USERNAME
  2. Looking to sell: ASUS Strix Gtx970
  3. Condition: New
  4. What I am looking for: PayPal/PP
  5. Extra Concerns: n/a
  1. Please use the following format for the title and message of a trading post:

Title

[T] [H] ASUS STRIX GTX970 [L$] Intel 5820K [Z] 95122 CA

  • [T]=Trading
  • [H]= The item that you are looking to trade
  • [L$]= What you want to get in a trade
  • [Z]= Shipping zip code or country

Message

  1. Heatware: USERNAME
  2. Looking to trade: ASUS Strix Gtx970
  3. Condition: New
  4. What I am looking for in a trade: Intel 5820K
  5. Condition of the trade: New
  6. Extra Concerns: n/a

 

BUYER PROTECTION SERVICES (BPS)

  • The most annoying, frustrating, and sometimes costly lesson online buyers have is that the item they are paying for is not the same item they are getting. Sometimes this might be as small as the seller failed to disclose the small scratches on the back of the device to a GPU which artifacts in games but is fine during normal browsing.
  • The Buyer Protection Service or BPS is a new idea on this problem many face. Subscribe to the marketplace to find out how we will implement this service at little cost but great benefit to you.
